destination.title: Quantum fields and gravity: descriptions, dynamics and consistency
destination.question: How are quantum and gravitational descriptions constructed and controlled, what determines their physical behavior and information, and which source-specific tests constrain their interpretation or possible applications?

sources.title: Thermal Schwinger pair production at arbitrary coupling

evidence.text: What is the leading exponential suppression of thermal Schwinger pair production at arbitrary charge coupling in weak external fields, and what inclusive fixed-energy rates follow?

sources.title: Euclidean wormholes, baby universes, and their impact on particle physics and cosmology

evidence.text: Do Euclidean wormholes contribute to physical quantum gravity, and can their effects coexist with local effective field theory? The review treats censorship, baby-universe states, and the interpretation of coupling constants as unresolved questions even for large, low-curvature configurations.

sources.title: A Measure of de Sitter entropy and eternal inflation

evidence.text: Does gauge invariance itself prevent local observables and time evolution? Introducing coordinate fields in nondynamical flat geometry shows that the relevant obstruction is dynamical gravity, which makes causal separation fluctuate and requires physical clocks.

sources.title: A Measure of de Sitter entropy and eternal inflation

evidence.text: Can low-curvature Hamiltonian evolution on nice slices describe an entire unitary evaporation? The reviewed paradox contrasts the entropy increase predicted by independent interior and exterior degrees of freedom with the shrinking information capacity assigned to the hole.

sources.title: Are we typical?

evidence.text: How should one ask what observers could have measured if a now-known quantity had been unknown? The paper requires a physical specification of which records may vary and which features continue to identify the conditioning system.

sources.title: A Covariant holographic entanglement entropy proposal

evidence.text: Can all subsystem entropies of one holographic state determine its classical bulk geometry? The proposed advantage over null-endpoint data is sensitivity to the metric's conformal factor and access to deeper bulk regions.

sources.title: A Covariant holographic entanglement entropy proposal

evidence.text: Can entanglement between otherwise noninteracting boundary theories explain nonzero correlations associated with a connected multiple-boundary bulk wormhole?

sources.title: An area law for one-dimensional quantum systems

evidence.text: How much entanglement can occur across a cut in the unique ground state of a finite one-dimensional chain when interaction range, interaction strength, and the excitation gap are controlled?

sources.title: A Short Review of Time Dependent Solutions and Space-like Singularities in String Theory

evidence.text: Does eliminating quotient fixed points eliminate causal pathology? Grant space shows that a smooth quotient can still contain CTCs, including curves through regions where the identification generator itself is spacelike.

sources.title: Euclidean wormholes in string theory

evidence.text: Can the axion and dilaton fields of a string compactification support a smooth Euclidean throat? The relevant classical equations use an indefinite scalar metric obtained by continuing the axionic variables while retaining ordinary dilaton kinetic signs.

sources.title: Schwinger pair production at finite temperature in scalar QED

evidence.text: How should an initial thermal fermion state be propagated through a time-dependent electric background, and how does the produced current alter that background? Both questions require ingredients beyond the fixed-background bosonic occupation calculation.

sources.title: k-Essence, superluminal propagation, causality and emergent geometry

evidence.text: Can physically realizable evolution form acoustic closed causal curves outside the backgrounds covered by temporal-function proofs? The paper invokes quantum backreaction by analogy with gravitational chronology protection.

sources.title: Viscosity Bound Violation in Higher Derivative Gravity

evidence.text: Can curvature-squared corrections violate the conjectured KSS bound η/s ≥ 1/(4π), and do violations correlate with bulk pathologies, inconsistent boundary theories, or restrictions on quantum-gravity embeddings?

sources.title: Weak Gravity Conjecture for the Effective Field Theories with N Species

evidence.text: How is the gauge weak-gravity cutoff altered when N separated abelian gauge sectors share the same bulk gravity?

sources.title: The Viscosity Bound and Causality Violation

evidence.text: Does reducing shear viscosity in the Gauss-Bonnet holographic model eventually violate boundary microcausality, thereby imposing a consistency-related lower bound on η/s?

sources.title: On Super-Planckian Fields at Sub-Planckian Energies

evidence.text: Assuming super-Planckian scalar ranges exist, can an observer in asymptotically flat space source and measure them in a finite local experiment without excessive gravitational backreaction or collapse?

sources.title: Building a Holographic Superconductor

evidence.text: Can a simple gravitational model describe a strongly coupled 2+1-dimensional system with a charged condensate, a superconducting transition and a gap in its frequency-dependent conductivity?

sources.title: Relative entropy and the Bekenstein bound

evidence.text: Can the Bekenstein bound receive an unambiguous flat-space QFT formulation using localized, vacuum-subtracted entropy and modular energy, and does that formulation follow from semiclassical generalized-second-law arguments without an additional physical principle?

sources.title: Investigating the Ultraviolet Properties of Gravity with a Wilsonian Renormalization Group Equation

evidence.text: Does gravitational RG flow admit a non-Gaussian ultraviolet fixed point with finitely many attractive directions, and how robust is the evidence under changes of cutoff scheme and truncation?

sources.title: (Un)attractor black holes in higher derivative AdS gravity

evidence.text: How do Gauss–Bonnet corrections affect renormalized charges, thermodynamics and scalar attractor behavior of static charged AdS black holes, including extremal solutions?

sources.title: Populating the swampland: The Case of U(1)**496 and E(8) x U(1)**248

evidence.text: Do U(1)^496 and E8×U(1)^248 ten-dimensional supergravities possess quantum-gravity completions? The paper tests requirements on compactification moduli spaces and on the fate of supersymmetric naked singularities, without assuming a string construction.

sources.title: Holographic Superconductors

evidence.text: How do gravitational backreaction and arbitrary scalar charge affect holographic condensation and transport, and what magnetic response, critical fields and photon mass follow from the model?

sources.title: Real time response on dS(3): The Topological AdS Black Hole and the Bubble

evidence.text: How do real-time correlators distinguish the topological black hole and bubble phases of strongly coupled N=4 SYM on dS3 × S1, reveal cosmological thermal effects, and characterize charge relaxation?

sources.title: Landscape versus Swampland for Higher Derivative Gravity

evidence.text: Can consistency requirements on holographic boundary theories distinguish negative-cosmological-constant Gauss–Bonnet gravity theories belonging to the string landscape from those in the swampland, and what do these examples imply for viscosity bounds?

sources.title: Holographic Hydrodynamics with a Chemical Potential

evidence.text: How do general four-derivative bulk interactions change finite-chemical-potential thermodynamics, shear viscosity and conductivity, and what happens to conjectured transport bounds?

sources.title: Higher derivative effects on eta/s at finite chemical potential

evidence.text: Does a finite U(1)R chemical potential modify η/s once supersymmetric four-derivative corrections are included, and does it strengthen or weaken violation of the proposed 1/(4π) viscosity bound?

sources.title: Renormalizability of Massive Gravity in Three Dimensions

evidence.text: Can three-dimensional new massive gravity be shown perturbatively renormalizable while preserving the special higher-derivative structure underlying its previously claimed unitary massive spin-2 spectrum?

sources.title: String Universality in Six Dimensions

evidence.text: Do low-energy consistency conditions characterize the six-dimensional supersymmetric quantum-gravity theories, and does every such consistent theory admit a string compactification? The paper tests this through anomaly constraints, explicit K3 constructions and apparently exceptional infinite families.

sources.title: Emergent quantum criticality, Fermi surfaces, and AdS(2)

evidence.text: How does the near-horizon geometry control low-frequency retarded correlators, Fermi-surface excitations and possible instabilities of strongly coupled finite-density systems?

sources.title: Quantum instability for charged scalar particles on charged Nariai and ultracold black hole manifolds

evidence.text: What vacuum pair-production instability does a charged scalar exhibit on charged ultracold I, ultracold II and Nariai backgrounds, and how does background thermality modify particle production?

sources.title: A Measure of de Sitter entropy and eternal inflation

evidence.text: Replace a model-specific fluctuation analysis by the adiabatic time-shift sector of a spatial-diffeomorphism-invariant effective action. This isolates a necessary source of dangerous fluctuations without requiring a complete microscopic matter Lagrangian.

sources.title: Are we typical?

evidence.text: Choose and disclose a theory-prior weighting that implements the desired typicality preference, then update it using the ordinary data likelihood. The procedure separates preference from evidence and exposes how conclusions depend on that preference.

sources.title: A Covariant holographic entanglement entropy proposal

evidence.text: Compare the radial metric factor with its pure-AdS value pointwise, then test the subtracted radial integral at zero and infinity. The explicit convergence conditions are added in the analytical reconstruction.

sources.title: An area law for one-dimensional quantum systems

evidence.text: Convert approximate ground-state projection into Schmidt-tail information, then sum shellwise entropy bounds. The operation separates an overlap assumption from the local Hamiltonian structure needed to turn it into a uniform entropy estimate.

sources.title: A Short Review of Time Dependent Solutions and Space-like Singularities in String Theory

evidence.text: Transfer a known electric-field oscillator realization to the twisted closed-string algebra, specifying the Hilbert space and ordering. This operation addresses fixed-background quantization; it supplies neither a unique spacetime vacuum nor a backreacted singularity resolution.

sources.title: Euclidean wormholes in string theory

evidence.text: Fourier project onto charges before extremizing, vary endpoint values as integration variables, solve the resulting complex equations, and retain all boundary terms in the weight. For wormholes, only dilatons must interpolate continuously between the specified physical end data.

sources.title: Weak gravity conjecture from conformal field theory: a challenge from hyperscaling violating and Kerr-Newman-AdS black holes

evidence.text: Can charged-scalar CFT correlation functions and their relaxation poles imply weak gravity conjecture conditions for hyperscaling violating (HSV) and Kerr-Newman-AdS (KNA) black holes, particularly near extremality?

sources.title: The dS / CFT correspondence

evidence.text: Can asymptotic symmetries and scalar boundary correlators support a holographic description of de Sitter quantum gravity by a Euclidean CFT, determine its central charge in three dimensions, and explain how bulk time and the two asymptotic boundaries are encoded?

sources.title: Non-equilibrium dynamics in Holography

evidence.text: Can entanglement entropy in DS/dS constrain the matter content of de Sitter quantum gravity? The thesis proposes such a criterion to investigate qualitative swampland claims within a specified holographic framework.

sources.title: Snowmass White Paper: Implications of Quantum Gravity for Particle Physics

evidence.text: Review how quantum-gravity consistency conditions constrain low-energy EFT and might inform strong CP, the weak scale, new gauge interactions and dark energy. The white paper explicitly does not guarantee that gravitational considerations solve these problems.

The paper also develops links between nuclearity, thermal stability and quantum energy inequalities (QEIs).

Why can nonperturbative QCD affect photon scattering even at very high collision energy? The forward limit keeps momentum transfer soft, allowing hadronic t-channel dynamics to contribute to the absorptive amplitude.

Can a conformally flat AdS chart simplify Dirac and Majorana equations, including formal imaginary-mass sectors, and support the authors' proposed mass constraints, preferred planar slices and trapped-ion simulations?

Can gravity-induced electric polarisation of dense matter account for stellar magnetic fields, a nearly universal magnetic-moment/angular-momentum ratio, and preferred or discrete stellar and pulsar masses?

What do exact, nonperturbative solutions of critical interacting scalar theories reveal about AdS/CFT, the information geometry of solution moduli, and classical scalar descriptions on de Sitter backgrounds?
